name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist studying Plankton has a higher distance than Bauer.
The Botanist's distance is immediately below the colonist in the Cortex module.
The colonist in the Aurora module's distance is between the Navigator and the colonist studying Fungus.
The colonist in the Forge module's distance is immediately next to the colonist studying Plankton.
Fontaine's distance is higher than both the colonist in the Aurora module and the colonist studying Algae.
